title: smime-tree: add negative tests — tampered ciphertext, tampered signature, tampered messageDigest
description: Three critical negative test cases are missing: (1) decrypt() on bit-flipped ciphertext returns DecryptionFailed, not panic/garbage. (2) verify() on tampered sig_bytes returns AllSignersFailed. (3) verify() where content_mime is modified but signature blob is intact returns failure (message-digest check). These cover the most important regression paths for a crypto library.
